name: SMA crossover 5/20 — TSM ADR, 15-minute RTH bars, long only (M3-B fixed baseline)

hypothesis.statement: On IBKR TSM 15-minute RTH bars, a completed-bar SMA5 crossing above SMA20 identifies short-horizon up-moves that continue long enough to earn a positive net return per round trip AFTER costs and BEYOND TSM's unconditional upward drift over the same holding time, consistently across the 2017-2024 development years.
hypothesis.mechanism: Information about TSM reaches the US ADR gradually: Taiwan-session news and semiconductor-sector flows are absorbed by US participants over hours, and large holders split orders over the session. Gradual incorporation creates short-horizon positive autocorrelation of 15m returns; the counterparties are liquidity providers and slower participants who trade against the move. Long-only by construction.
hypothesis.falsifiable_prediction: Pre-registered success requires ALL of: (1) >= 30 valid round trips; (2) BASE and STRESS net expectancy > 0 and STRESS profit factor > 1; (3) DRIFT-MATCHED-v1 mean excess per trade > 0 under BASE (timing beyond beta); (4) net PnL > 0 in at least 5 of the 8 calendar years and in both halves 2017-2020 and 2021-2024; (5) no single calendar year provides more than 50% of total net PnL. Any failure = hypothesis not supported on Development data.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: Net returns of crossover trades are no better than random-entry long trades with the same holding-time distribution (DRIFT-MATCHED-v1 mean excess <= 0), or net expectancy <= 0 after BASE/STRESS costs.
hypothesis.expected_holding_period: several 15-minute bars to a few sessions
known_failure_modes: overnight gaps (positions may be held overnight)
ADR reaction to Taiwan-hours information outside RTH
profit is long-only market beta from TSM's 2017-2024 rise rather than timing (tested by DRIFT-MATCHED-v1)
edge concentrated in one regime or year (tested by pre-registered year / half / regime decomposition)
references: Phase 5-C1 pre-registration (docs/PHASE5C1_PREREGISTRATION.md); baseline fixed since M3-B, not re-selected on results
